$comment: Known accessibility defects originating in Tecton design tokens (SPEC §11.3: Tecton owns visual tokens). They are NOT approved exceptions and NOT compliant: every run reports them as 'tecton-token defect (unapproved)'. A defect not listed here fails the build. To approve one, move it to a11y-exceptions.json with owner, rationale, reviewer approval and follow-up via PR.

defects.detail: Tecton selected-day spec (Figma 16874:80020) pairs text/primary with action/primary/activeBackground.
Data Grid / Table header title text in dark mode.
